name: holybook
description: Research the authoritative Bahá'í writings and translate texts that quote them, using the official translations.

interface.shortDescription: Research and quote the Bahá'í writings
interface.longDescription: Search the authoritative Bahá'í writings (Bahá'u'lláh, the Báb, 'Abdu'l-Bahá, Shoghi Effendi, the Universal House of Justice) in several languages and answer with exact, cited quotations. When translating a text that quotes the writings, look up the authoritative translation of every quotation instead of retranslating it.
defaultPrompt: What do the Bahá'í writings say about consultation?
Translate this talk into German, using the authoritative translations of all quotations.
